findings.title: Persistent delta lookup and extension hide branch-depth work
findings.closure: Meter every visited persistent node, stop before work after a failed charge, prove deep present/absent/extension boundaries, and reject runtime unmetered bypasses.

findings.title: Remaining target-sized branch and result work is not mechanically charged
findings.closure: Give every target-sized traversal, allocation, copy, comparison, insertion, and head derivation one exact owner and prove zero work after the first stop.

findings.title: The authoritative NIP contradicts Event-only unsupported identity
findings.closure: Make unverified unsupported change-shaped evidence Event-only in every authority and implementation, then regenerate the affected identities.

findings.title: Deep persistent Arc-chain teardown is not qualified
findings.closure: Prove bounded-stack destruction for deep unique chains and wide shared forks without changing protocol output.

findings.title: External assurance and publication authority remain held
findings.closure: Preserve the hold; it cannot be closed by this local sequence.
